description: Rule-2 cluster buys only (>=2 insiders buying the same issuer in-window) — the highest-signal subset. Each row carries `uniform_price_cluster`: true when >=3 distinct insiders bought at the IDENTICAL price on the same filed_date for the same issuer — the fingerprint of an offering/conversion (one administered price), NOT independent open-market conviction. Note Form-4 code P covers open-market purchases AND some offering/conversion purchases filed under P; this flag marks the latter. Genuine clusters rank ABOVE uniform-price ones. Returns the newest 25 by default (set `limit`; page with `offset`; optional `days`/`ticker`); `total_matched` reports the full count. Each record carries its source filing_url.

days.description: Only rows filed within the last N days (relative to today).

limit.description: Max rows to return (default 25, newest first). Page with offset; the response's total_matched shows the full count. limit<=0 = no cap.

offset.description: Rows to skip before this page (pagination). Default 0.

ticker.description: Case-insensitive exact ticker filter, e.g. DKS.
